messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: embeddings route 'embeddings-hot-2' experiencing sustained QPS spike (3x baseline) and elevated 429s. Investigate. https://metrics.redwood/embeddings-hot-2
alex: taking lead, paging oncall
jamal: on it, looking at pool + route quotas
maria: customer-impact: multiple enterprise customers see intermittent 429s on bulk-embed calls, chat still ok for most customers
jamal: dashboard shows pool-7 GPU queue length + request latency climbing, tail latency > 2.5s
alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-enterprise embeddings traffic 2) reduce per-endpoint qps for embeddings-hot-2 3) temporarily disable rerank for free-tier to free up capacity
maria: agreed, need to notify CS for affected customers after mitigation
jamal: executing quota tweak now
jamal: ```
POST /admin/quotas HTTP/1.1
Host: controlplane.internal
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{"route":"embeddings-hot-2","scope":"per-endpoint","qps":120} 
```
jamal: API returned 200, change enqueued :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Change applied: embeddings-hot-2 per-endpoint qps -> 120 (propagation ~10s)
liz: also pushed rerank rule: disable rerank for tier=free via route matcher (rule id: rr-disable-free-2026)
alex: rolling out chat priority pin for low-latency customers (no change to chat global qps)
jamal: monitoring: embeddings 429 rate dropped 8% -> 2% over last 90s, pool CPU stable at 72%
maria: CS note: drafting message to impacted customers, will include ETA and mitigation details
sara: FYI I'll take handoff in 30m. Will watch embeddings and rerank dashboards and escalate if headroom < 1.5x
alex: one follow-up: create ticket for autoscale policy review for embeddings pools (thresholds + burst handling)
customer-success: thanks — will hold off external comm until you confirm stabilization
jamal: recommend re-enable rerank for paid tiers once error rate < 1% for 10m or headroom >= 2x. Adding runbook note.
alex: confirmed, no data loss or security impact. Severity: minor, customer-facing rate limits only
ops-bot: Incident log: mitigations applied (per-endpoint qps reduction, rerank free-tier disable, chat priority pin). Duration so far: 18m
sara: ack, taking over monitoring and will post summary to incidents channel in 1h
oncall-bot: Incident auto-close scheduled if metrics remain stable for 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
